text:
```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cdk_version:
        description: 'CDK version to publish (e.g., 7.6.5)'
        required: true
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry run (do not push images)'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  publish-cdk-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and Push CDK Base Image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: airbyte-integrations/bases/base-cdk/java/Dockerfile
          push: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/airbyte/source-declarative-manifest:${{ inputs.cdk_version }}
            ghcr.io/airbyte/source-declarative-manifest:latest
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            CDK_VERSION=${{ inputs.cdk_version }}
```
